description:
Upgrade Your Ride with Premium Protection for the 2025-2026 Chevy Equinox & GMC Terrain
Give your vehicle the professional-grade protection it deserves with OEDRO’s Custom-Fit Floor Mat & Cargo Liner Set. Specifically designed for the 2025 2026 Chevy Equinox (Gas Only) and GMC Terrain, this full interior solution covers every inch of your floor and trunk area, including the often-neglected backrest of the rear seats.
Whether you are navigating a rainy commute, hauling muddy sports gear, or traveling with pets, our GRS-certified TPE liners act as an impenetrable barrier. Unlike cheap universal mats, OEDRO uses 3D laser scanning technology to ensure a seamless fit that aligns perfectly with your car’s contours, preventing spills from reaching your factory carpet and preserving your vehicle’s resale value.
The sophisticated aesthetic, inspired by modern automotive design, complements your interior while the rugged construction stands up to daily wear and tear. With OEDRO, you aren't just buying floor mats; you are investing in a cleaner, safer, and more comfortable driving environment. Join over 300 vehicle models’ worth of satisfied customers and experience the OEDRO difference today!
Features
Precision Custom Fit for 2025-2026: Utilizing advanced 3D laser scanning technology, OEDRO floor liners are engineered to fit the 2025 2026 Chevy Equinox (Gas Models) and GMC Terrain like a glove. The edge-to-edge design ensures zero pedal interference for maximum driving safety.
Ultimate Cargo & Backrest Protection: This comprehensive set includes not only front and rear floor mats but also a custom-fit trunk mat with backrest protectors. Your vehicle’s upholstery is fully shielded from scratches and dirt, even when the rear seats are folded down.
Eco-Friendly GRS Certified TPE: Crafted from high-density, GRS-certified recyclable TPE material. These mats are 100% odorless, non-toxic, and pet-friendly. They remain flexible and durable even in extreme temperatures without cracking or warping.
All-Weather Shield & Anti-Slip Design: Designed to tackle mud, snow, sand, and liquid spills. The unique tread patterns channel fluids away from your feet, while the anti-slip nibs on the bottom keep the mats securely in place, protecting your original carpet in any season.
Effortless Maintenance & Brand Trust: Cleaning is as simple as a quick shake or a hose down. As a specialist with over 10 years of experience in floor liners, OEDRO provides premium quality backed by dedicated US-based customer support for a worry-free shopping experience.
2 years warranty. For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
